HCSEC-2026-15 states a user with host-volume-create and node-read can submit a host-volume create with a target NodeID and a PluginID that traverses out of the plugin directory, executing a non-plugin executable as the Nomad agent. At fix parent 62bf44e1b1d2ccb9bf10c1338d803512f9dbd1d2, nomad/host_volume_endpoint.go:183-222 enforces host-volume-create ACL; placeHostVolume at 523-533 returns immediately for an explicit NodeID without the plugins.host_volume.<id>.version is_set checker built at 561-566; createVolume at 466-480 forwards vol.PluginID unchanged to ClientHostVolume.Create. Client HostVolume.Create at client/host_volume_endpoint.go:25-33 passes the request to hostVolumeManager.Create; getPlugin at host_volumes.go:230-236 supplies req.PluginID as filename to NewHostVolumePluginExternal; host_volume_plugin.go:229-230 does executable := filepath.Join(pluginDir, filename) then os.Stat, and Create/fingerprint invoke exec.CommandContext on p.Executable (lines 278, 435). Traversal-bearing PluginID therefore escapes the plugin directory and runs as the agent user.
